description: The silver car tracked as car #10 is visibly occupying the marked restricted-zone polygon in the event keyframe. It appears to move slightly forward between the before, event, and after frames, remaining within or overlapping the ROI. Thus, a restricted-zone presence/intrusion is visually supported, although the exact moment it first entered is not established by these frames.
visual_evidence: In the annotated event frame, car #10's bounding box substantially overlaps the red restricted-zone polygon.
The same silver car is visible in the before frame in approximately the same central-lane position, already near or overlapping the area corresponding to the ROI.
In the after frame, the silver car remains in essentially the same lane and continues to overlap or sit within the ROI area, with only slight forward movement.
The tracked object is visually a car; there is no clear indication that the box is attached to another object.
uncertainties: The ROI is only explicitly drawn in the event frame, so its exact boundary in the clean frames must be inferred from the annotated frame.
Because the car appears already near or inside the ROI in the before frame, these images do not conclusively prove a new entry occurred at the event timestamp.
The bounding box and perspective make the precise position of the car's contact point with the ROI boundary somewhat ambiguous.
recommended_action: Treat as a likely valid restricted-zone intrusion/presence and retain for review, but verify the preceding tracking frames and ROI calibration before taking enforcement action based specifically on the claimed entry time.
